main_text.p: Confiliorum ibid. Aut comparatis. lib.7. epist.28.lib.11.epist.24. Pars quarta & postrema conclusio absoluetur: ἀνοχῆς[?] pollicitatione aduentus.lib.2. epist.15. auxilij.lib.11. epist.24. Vel noftrae voluntatis declaratione. libro 2. epistola 13. libro 9. epistola 15. Vel ἀξιώσει[?] petitione: vt posthac, si quid acciderit noui certiores nos amicus reddat. libro 14. epistola 8. Sunt autem talium responsionum variae Cicero-Materiae re-fponfionum ad epistolas nunciatorias.ronis in epistolis famil.materiae.Respon-fiones ad nunciationes de rebus urbanis. libro secundo, epistola octaua. Supplica-tione.lib.2.epist.15.Amicitia ac familiari-tate certorum.lib.2.epist.13.lib.7. epist.15.. Ratione belli tempore instituta. lib.7. epist. 29. lib. 8. epist. 16. Valetudine. lib.9. epist.15.lib.16.epist.12. Auxiliis belli tempore paratis.libro vndecimo,epistola 24. Literis ab amico missis. lib.14. epistola 8. Reipublicae statu perturbato. lib.7. epist. 28.Est & egregia Bruti ad Ciceronem epistola quarta, responsio ad nunciatoriam de victoria ab hostibus reportata, quam exprimere conabimur, vbi imitationis exemplum,in refpondendo aliorum nun-ciationibus, de rebus instıtutis priuatis, proposuerimus. Sumemus autem lib.7.

page.notes: Printed page number reads "28y", transcribed as 287; the final digit is uncertain. The Greek words ἀνοχῆς and ἀξιώσει are doubtful readings, marked [?]. The marginal note is printed in the right margin, placed at the Cicero-ronis line. Several words of the running text are slightly blurred, notably "reportata", "instituta" and "auxilij", but I read them as printed. Abbreviations and the long s have been kept as printed, with s and u/v normalised as required.
